title: Fabric record evidence v1 (draft, spec 050 §3.4a)
description: The one structured-evidence carrier: the body of a records-input record's single record.evidence content object (media type application/vnd.fabric.record-evidence+json, at most 1 MiB, spec-029 canonical JSON). It carries structured metadata that has no single telemetry key (lists of objects, per-item metadata, correlations, indexes, continuation ranges) as items of one registered, closed evidence type (field-registry-v1.json evidence_types); never CONTENT: content travels in its own role and evidence refers to it only by locator (refs). The Node checks this envelope, the registered type and the bounds before acknowledgement; fabric.reconstruct validates each item against its type schema and projects the registry's pointers into field wrappers. Bounds: at most 4096 items, item depth 4, strings of 256 characters, 64 refs.

items.description: Objects closed by the evidence type's schema (additionalProperties false; strings pattern-checked).

continuation.description: Bounded continuation (spec 050 §3.13): this record's window index within its attempt, and whether it is the last.

refs.description: Locators into this record's bodies (an object of fabric.content.object_ids): a JSON pointer or a half-open byte range.
